Varianceλ
Actual less budget, positive when favourable for income and expenses

/*  FUNCTION NAME:  Varianceλ
    DESCRIPTION:*//**Actual less budget, signed so a favourable variance is positive for income and expense lines alike*/

Varianceλ = LAMBDA(
//  Parameter Declaration
    [Actual],
    [Budget],
    [Type],
    LET(
    //  Help
        Help,           TRIM(TEXTSPLIT(
                            "FUNCTION:      →Varianceλ(Actual, Budget, [Type])¶" &
                            "DESCRIPTION:   →Actual less budget, signed so a favourable variance is positive for income and expense lines alike.¶" &
                            "NOTES!         →Type 1 marks income, where an actual above budget is favourable; -1 marks an¶               →expense, where an actual below budget is favourable. Enter expenses as positive¶               →costs: for a ledger that stores them as negative balances, negate both amounts¶               →first. Give one Type for all lines or a column of them, one for each row. Actual¶               →and Budget must be the same shape and hold numbers or blank cells, which count as¶               →0; text and TRUE or FALSE return a message. Budget may also be a prior period.¶               →VariancePctλ() gives the percentage.¶" &
                            "WEBPAGE:       →https://github.com/ryanduguid/Ozzit¶" &
                            "VERSION:       →20 Oct 2026¶" &
                            "PARAMETERS:    →¶" &
                            "Actual         →(Required) One or more actual amounts.¶" &
                            "Budget         →(Required) The budget or comparison amounts, the same shape as Actual.¶" &
                            "Type           →(Optional: Default = 1) 1 for income or -1 for an expense recorded as a positive cost, one value or one for each row.¶" &
                            "EXAMPLES:      →¶" &
                            "→Formula (oz is assumed to be the module's name)¶" &
                            "→=oz.Varianceλ({120;90}, {100;100}, {1;-1})¶" &
                            "→Result¶" &
                            "→20, 10",
                            "→", "¶"
                        )),
    //  Check inputs - Omitted required arguments
        Help?,          OR(ISOMITTED(Actual), ISOMITTED(Budget)),
    //  Set defaults. Only a single blank Type means income: a blank inside a column of
    //  Types is a missing entry and is refused, not read as income.
        Sign,           IF(ISOMITTED(Type), 1, IF(AND(ROWS(Type) = 1, COLUMNS(Type) = 1), IF(Type = "", 1, Type), Type)),
    //  Arithmetic would read "120" as 120 and TRUE as 1. An error passes so it shows.
        Amounts?,       AND(ISNUMBER(Actual) + ISBLANK(Actual) + ISERROR(Actual),
                            ISNUMBER(Budget) + ISBLANK(Budget) + ISERROR(Budget)),
    //  Arrays of other shapes would broadcast into a grid of plausible numbers
        Rows,           ROWS(Actual),
        Cols,           COLUMNS(Actual),
        Shaped?,        AND(ROWS(Budget) = Rows, COLUMNS(Budget) = Cols,
                            OR(AND(ROWS(Sign) = 1, COLUMNS(Sign) = 1),
                                AND(ROWS(Sign) = Rows, OR(COLUMNS(Sign) = 1, COLUMNS(Sign) = Cols)))),
    //  ABS(TRUE) is 1, so the type test is ISNUMBER as well as the size
        ValidType?,     AND(IFERROR(ISNUMBER(Sign) * (ABS(Sign) = 1) = 1, FALSE)),
        AmountMessage,  "Varianceλ needs Actual and Budget to hold numbers or blank cells; text and TRUE or FALSE are refused.",
        ShapeMessage,   "Varianceλ needs Actual and Budget of the same shape, and Type as one value or one for each row.",
        TypeMessage,    "Varianceλ needs Type to be 1 for income or -1 for an expense in every entry.",
        Result,         (Actual - Budget) * Sign,
    //  Return Result, Help or the message
        Return,         IF(Help?, 2, IF(NOT(Amounts?), 3, IF(NOT(Shaped?), 4, IF(NOT(ValidType?), 5, 1)))),
        CHOOSE( Return, Result, Help, AmountMessage, ShapeMessage, TypeMessage)
    )
);

VariancePctλ
Variance as a fraction of the budget's size, keeping its sign

/*  FUNCTION NAME:  VariancePctλ
    DESCRIPTION:*//**Variance as a fraction of the budget's size, so its sign always matches the variance even when the budget is negative*/

VariancePctλ = LAMBDA(
//  Parameter Declaration
    [Actual],
    [Budget],
    [Type],
    LET(
    //  Help
        Help,           TRIM(TEXTSPLIT(
                            "FUNCTION:      →VariancePctλ(Actual, Budget, [Type])¶" &
                            "DESCRIPTION:   →The variance from Varianceλ() as a fraction of the budget's size.¶" &
                            "NOTES!         →Dividing by the budget's absolute value keeps the sign of the variance, so a¶               →favourable variance stays positive when the budget is negative, as a work in¶               →progress movement or a loss can be. A zero budget returns #DIV/0!. Type 1 marks¶               →income and -1 an expense recorded as a positive cost, and the inputs follow the¶               →same rules as in Varianceλ().¶" &
                            "WEBPAGE:       →https://github.com/ryanduguid/Ozzit¶" &
                            "VERSION:       →20 Oct 2026¶" &
                            "PARAMETERS:    →¶" &
                            "Actual         →(Required) One or more actual amounts.¶" &
                            "Budget         →(Required) The budget or comparison amounts, the same shape as Actual.¶" &
                            "Type           →(Optional: Default = 1) 1 for income or -1 for an expense recorded as a positive cost, one value or one for each row.¶" &
                            "EXAMPLES:      →¶" &
                            "→Formula (oz is assumed to be the module's name)¶" &
                            "→=oz.VariancePctλ(-30, -20)¶" &
                            "→Result¶" &
                            "→-50%",
                            "→", "¶"
                        )),
    //  Check inputs - Omitted required arguments
        Help?,          OR(ISOMITTED(Actual), ISOMITTED(Budget)),
    //  Set defaults and check inputs as in Varianceλ: only a single blank Type means income
        Sign,           IF(ISOMITTED(Type), 1, IF(AND(ROWS(Type) = 1, COLUMNS(Type) = 1), IF(Type = "", 1, Type), Type)),
        Amounts?,       AND(ISNUMBER(Actual) + ISBLANK(Actual) + ISERROR(Actual),
                            ISNUMBER(Budget) + ISBLANK(Budget) + ISERROR(Budget)),
        Rows,           ROWS(Actual),
        Cols,           COLUMNS(Actual),
        Shaped?,        AND(ROWS(Budget) = Rows, COLUMNS(Budget) = Cols,
                            OR(AND(ROWS(Sign) = 1, COLUMNS(Sign) = 1),
                                AND(ROWS(Sign) = Rows, OR(COLUMNS(Sign) = 1, COLUMNS(Sign) = Cols)))),
        ValidType?,     AND(IFERROR(ISNUMBER(Sign) * (ABS(Sign) = 1) = 1, FALSE)),
        AmountMessage,  "VariancePctλ needs Actual and Budget to hold numbers or blank cells; text and TRUE or FALSE are refused.",
        ShapeMessage,   "VariancePctλ needs Actual and Budget of the same shape, and Type as one value or one for each row.",
        TypeMessage,    "VariancePctλ needs Type to be 1 for income or -1 for an expense in every entry.",
    //  Dividing by the budget itself would flip the sign when the budget is negative
        Result,         (Actual - Budget) * Sign / ABS(Budget),
    //  Return Result, Help or the message
        Return,         IF(Help?, 2, IF(NOT(Amounts?), 3, IF(NOT(Shaped?), 4, IF(NOT(ValidType?), 5, 1)))),
        CHOOSE( Return, Result, Help, AmountMessage, ShapeMessage, TypeMessage)
    )
);

YearToDateλ
Totals each row from the start of the financial year to an as-at date

/*  FUNCTION NAME:  YearToDateλ
    DESCRIPTION:*//**Totals each row of values from the start of the financial year to an as-at date*/

YearToDateλ = LAMBDA(
//  Parameter Declaration
    [Values],
    [Dates],
    [AsAt],
    [StartMonth],
    LET(
    //  Help
        Help,           TRIM(TEXTSPLIT(
                            "FUNCTION:      →YearToDateλ(Values, Dates, AsAt, [StartMonth])¶" &
                            "DESCRIPTION:   →Totals each row of Values from the start of AsAt's financial year to AsAt.¶" &
                            "NOTES!         →A column counts when its date is on or after the first day of the financial¶               →year that contains AsAt, and on or before AsAt; a time of day is ignored. Date¶               →each column by the first day of its period, or by its last day and an AsAt at a¶               →period end. A part period counts in full, not pro rata. Values must hold numbers¶               →or blank cells, which count as 0; text and TRUE or FALSE return a message, and an¶               →error in any column shows. The result is one total for each row of Values. A¶               →financial year starting before 1 January 1900 returns #NUM!.¶" &
                            "WEBPAGE:       →https://github.com/ryanduguid/Ozzit¶" &
                            "VERSION:       →20 Oct 2026¶" &
                            "PARAMETERS:    →¶" &
                            "Values         →(Required) A row or block of amounts, one column for each date in Dates.¶" &
                            "Dates          →(Required) A row of dates, one for each column of Values.¶" &
                            "AsAt           →(Required) The one date the total runs to, inclusive.¶" &
                            "StartMonth     →(Optional: Default = 7) Month the financial year starts, one whole number from 1 to 12. Blank cells and empty text use 7.¶" &
                            "EXAMPLES:      →¶" &
                            "→Formula (oz is assumed to be the module's name)¶" &
                            "→=oz.YearToDateλ({10,20,30,40;1,2,3,4}, DATE(2026,{5,6,7,8},1), DATE(2026,8,31))¶" &
                            "→Result¶" &
                            "→70, 7",
                            "→", "¶"
                        )),
    //  Check inputs - Omitted required arguments
        Help?,          OR(ISOMITTED(Values), ISOMITTED(Dates), ISOMITTED(AsAt)),
    //  Set defaults. A range of start months would give each column its own year.
        FYStart,        IF(ISOMITTED(StartMonth), 7, IF(StartMonth = "", 7, StartMonth)),
        ValidStart?,    IF(AND(ROWS(FYStart) = 1, COLUMNS(FYStart) = 1), IFERROR(OR(FYStart = SEQUENCE(12)), FALSE), FALSE),
        Shaped?,        AND(ROWS(Dates) = 1, COLUMNS(Dates) = COLUMNS(Values), ISNUMBER(Dates)),
        OneDate?,       AND(ROWS(AsAt) = 1, COLUMNS(AsAt) = 1, ISNUMBER(AsAt)),
    //  Values * 1 would read "10" as 10 and TRUE as 1. An error passes so it shows.
        Numbers?,       AND(ISNUMBER(Values) + ISBLANK(Values) + ISERROR(Values)),
        StartMessage,   "YearToDateλ needs StartMonth to be one whole number from 1 to 12.",
        ShapeMessage,   "YearToDateλ needs Dates to be one row with a date for each column of Values.",
        AsAtMessage,    "YearToDateλ needs AsAt to be one date.",
        ValuesMessage,  "YearToDateλ needs Values to hold numbers or blank cells; text and TRUE or FALSE are refused.",
    //  The first day of the financial year that contains AsAt. EDATE rather than a year
    //  less one, which DATE reads as 3799 for 1899.
        YearStart,      EDATE(DATE(YEAR(AsAt), FYStart, 1), -12 * (MONTH(AsAt) < FYStart)),
        InYear,         (INT(Dates) >= YearStart) * (INT(Dates) <= INT(AsAt)),
        Result,         MMULT(Values * 1, TRANSPOSE(InYear)),
    //  Return Result, Help or the message
        Return,         IF(Help?, 2, IF(NOT(ValidStart?), 3, IF(NOT(Shaped?), 4, IF(NOT(OneDate?), 5, IF(NOT(Numbers?), 6, 1))))),
        CHOOSE( Return, Result, Help, StartMessage, ShapeMessage, AsAtMessage, ValuesMessage)
    )
);
